sents.zh: 我的房间里有很多书，放得到处都是。
sents.en: My room is full of books, all over the place.

sents.zh: 有的是新的，有的已经很旧了。
sents.en: Some are new, some are already old.

sents.zh: 书里有很多有意思的故事。
有的书说的是很久以前的事情。
sents.en: Some are about things from long ago.

sents.zh: 里面有皇帝，有长城，还有大禹。
sents.en: In them are emperors, the Great Wall, and Dayu.

sents.zh: 有的书说的是天上和水里的动物。
sents.en: Some are about the animals of the sky and the water.

sents.zh: 我看书的时候，就像去了很远的地方。
sents.en: When I read, it is as if I have gone somewhere far away.

sents.zh: 有时候我看得太认真，妈妈叫我都听不到。
sents.en: Sometimes I read so intently that I do not hear my mother call.

sents.zh: 她说：“看书让你成为一个更好的人。”
sents.en: She says: "Reading makes you a better person."

sents.zh: 她还说，不认识的字可以问她。
sents.en: She also says I can ask her about any character I do not know.

sents.zh: 所以我常常放着一本小本子。
sents.en: So I often keep a small notebook to hand.

sents.zh: 看到新的字，我就写下来。
sents.en: When I meet a new character, I write it down.

sents.zh: 每天晚上，我都要看一会书。
sents.en: Every evening I read for a while.

sents.zh: 虽然我已经看了很多书，但是我还想看更多。
sents.en: Although I have already read many books, I want to read more.
